title: Personal Checking: Stop Payment Pricing, Replacement Card Fees and Check Writing
content:
## Summary

Each Personal Checking tier decides whether paper checks can be written at all, what a stop payment order costs and how many are free each cycle, and what a replacement debit card costs.

## Tier matrix

| Tier | Paper checks allowed | Stop payment fee (USD) | Free stop orders per cycle | Standard replacement card (USD) | Rush delivery add-on (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Access Checking | no (checkless) | 32.00 | 0 | 5.00 | 25.00 |
| Student Checking | yes | 32.00 | 0 | 0.00 | 25.00 |
| Everyday Checking | yes | 32.00 | 0 | 5.00 | 25.00 |
| Interest Checking | yes | 32.00 | 1 | 5.00 | 25.00 |
| Premier Checking | yes | 32.00 | 2 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Private Client Checking | yes | 32.00 | 5 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

## Column notes

- **Paper checks allowed** — "no" marks a checkless account on which paper checks cannot be written.
- **Stop payment fee** — the charge for each stop payment order or renewal beyond the free allowance.
- **Free stop orders per cycle** — stop payment orders and renewals placed without charge in one statement cycle.
- **Standard replacement card** — the fee for a replacement debit card sent by standard delivery when the card was lost or damaged.
- **Rush delivery add-on** — the extra fee for delivery of a replacement debit card within two business days.

## Q&A

**Is the stop payment price the same everywhere?** Yes, 32.00 USD on every tier; tiers differ only in how many orders each cycle are free.

**Hypothetical: a Premier Checking owner places three stop orders in one cycle.** Two fall within the free allowance of 2 and the third is priced at 32.00 USD.
